reviews.title: MSI Z890 Gaming Plus WiFi Gaming Motherboard – A Powerhouse for Gamers and Enthusiasts
reviews.comment:
The MSI Z890 Gaming Plus WiFi is a stellar choice for gamers and PC builders looking for top-tier performance, reliability, and future-proof features. Whether you're into high-performance gaming, content creation, or overclocking, this motherboard delivers in every aspect.
Performance & Compatibility
Equipped with Intel’s Z890 chipset, this board supports the latest 14th Gen Intel Core processors, ensuring blazing-fast speeds and multitasking capabilities. It also supports DDR5 memory, allowing for high-speed RAM up to 7800+ MHz (OC), which is perfect for power users who demand ultra-low latency and maximum bandwidth.
Robust Build & Cooling
MSI has nailed the thermal design with extended heatsinks, MOSFET thermal pads, and an advanced 7W/mK thermal solution to keep everything running cool under load. This is especially beneficial for overclockers looking to push their CPUs and GPUs to the limit without worrying about thermal throttling.
Connectivity & Expansion
This board features PCIe 5.0 support, ensuring compatibility with the latest GPUs and ultra-fast NVMe SSDs for unparalleled data transfer speeds. The inclusion of multiple M.2 slots with Shield Frozr heatsinks is a great touch, protecting your SSDs from overheating.
Networking & Wireless
The WiFi 7 and 2.5G LAN provide lightning-fast internet connectivity, making lag a thing of the past whether you're gaming, streaming, or working remotely. The WiFi 7 support future-proofs your setup, ensuring that you get the fastest possible wireless speeds.
User-Friendly BIOS & Software
MSI’s Click BIOS 5 is incredibly intuitive, making overclocking, tweaking settings, and system monitoring a breeze. The MSI Center software also provides a great dashboard for controlling RGB lighting, system diagnostics, and more.
Final Verdict
The MSI Z890 Gaming Plus WiFi is a high-performance, feature-packed motherboard that offers everything a modern gamer or power user could ask for. From blazing-fast memory and PCIe 5.0 support to top-tier cooling and connectivity, this board is built for those who want the best.
reviews.author: Garrhett Franko

reviews.title: Producto dañado
reviews.comment: Compré esta placa en enero lo recibí la caja sin sello original pero en el momento no lo vi mal, fui comprando poco a poco las demás piezas y comencé el ensamble a finales de abril y es cuando me percato que la placa tiene un pin roto en el socket del procesador, ya se me pasó el tiempo de la devolución por lo que me tocará buscar como repárarla por mi cuenta, deben reforzar el control de calidad ya que la misma venía con defectos de fábrica o peor aún ya era un producto usado y no lo noté en el momento de decirla.

reviews.title: It just works
reviews.comment: I don't have much to say about this.  It was cost-effective.  It works with my Ultra 7 270k.  It could use a few more USB ports.  I like the 5Gbps NIC although I've installed a 10Gbps NIC anyway.  I did update the BIOS before doing anything else.

reviews.title: Good stuff
reviews.comment: Pretty good mb. Seems like a good quality love how easy it is to flash and upgrade. BIOS is very fancy but still a bit painful to use if you don't have previous experience. Been buying MSI for a while and so far not disappointed. Wifi that comes with this MB is really "Killer" probably best I've seen so far. Thumbs up!
